letter.method: Poisson blend of approved clean donor grain into original inner-edge lighting; original high-resolution frame outside mask and all alpha preserved. No generated RGB.
letter.cornerRefinement: Blend mask follows the true paper contour through all four corners, excluding gold carving; 5-native-pixel smooth boundary prevents detached restoration patches.
